links.outcome: Correct calculation of disability percentages by LLMs across scenarios
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o failed to calculate correct disability percentages in 55.6% of scenarios; Data Analyst failed in 88.9%.
links.quote: However, ChatGPT-4o failed to calculate correct disability percentages in 55.6%, and Data Analyst failed in 88.9% of scenarios.

links.outcome: Reliability of AI-generated disability reports and percentage calculations requiring expert review
links.effect: Narrative reports were rated very good (ChatGPT-4o) and good (Data Analyst), but disability percentage calculations were frequently wrong, so expert oversight remains essential.
links.quote: While NLP tools can assist in generating structured disability reports, they currently lack the precision needed for calculating disability percentages reliably.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT-4o performance on simulated patient scenarios for musculoskeletal disability assessment and percentage calculation.
